versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-rednote-pulse.

- Enables retrieval of XiaoHongShu (小红书) public content: keyword note search, note detail lookup, comment extraction, and creator post list, with structured JSON output.
- Supports selection topics, competitor monitoring, KOL filtering, and comment sentiment analysis.
- Triggers on xiaohongshu.com/xhslink.com URLs or related keywords; only public data, no login/publishing/private data access.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access; instructions and developer support provided.
- Multiple command-line scripts with configurable parameters for flexible data collection scenarios.
